title: GST Filing Registration Company
description: Stay ahead on GST compliance and register for GST online for free! GST is a tax registration which is required for all Indian businesses meeting similar requirements like, Making sales outside your state, Annual sales are higher than Rs 40 Lakhs & E-commerce Seller.

value: GST registration is the process by which a business in India becomes liable to pay Goods and Services Tax (GST). It is mandatory for businesses whose annual turnover exceeds the prescribed threshold limit. The threshold limit for GST registration varies depending on the type of business and the state in which it is located.

Once a business is registered under GST, it is assigned a unique 15-digit identification number called the Goods and Services Tax Identification Number (GSTIN). The GSTIN is used to track all GST transactions made by the business.

value.title: Central GST (CGST)
value: This is the tax levied by the central government on all goods and services sold or consumed within a state.

value.title: State GST (SGST)
value: This is the tax levied by the state government on all goods and services sold or consumed within a state.

value.title: Integrated GST (IGST)
value: This is the tax levied by the central government on all goods and services sold or consumed from one state to another.

value.title: Union Territory GST (UTGST)
value: This is the tax levied by the central government on all goods and services sold or consumed within a union territory.

value.title: Normal taxable person

value.title: Composition scheme
value: This is a simplified GST registration scheme that is available to small businesses with an annual turnover of up to Rs. 1.5 crore. Businesses under the composition scheme pay a fixed monthly tax instead of the regular GST rates.

value.title: Increased transparency

value.title: Increased efficiency

If you are a business owner in India, you should consider registering for GST if your annual turnover exceeds the prescribed threshold limit. GST registration can help you save money on taxes, improve your compliance, and boost your efficiency.

h1: TIN Facilitation Centre Registration in Chennai
description: TAN Registration is mandatory for making tax collection or tax deduction at source, issuance and remittance of TDS Payment and Certificates. Aanoor Global provides TAN registration at an affordable rate.

value: TAN stands for Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number. It is a 10-digit alpha-numeric number issued by the Income Tax Department of India to individuals or entities that are required to deduct tax at source (TDS) or collect tax at source (TCS).

TDS is a system by which the government collects tax from individuals or entities before they actually receive the income. This is done by requiring the payer to deduct a certain percentage of the amount payable to the recipient and remit it to the government. TCS is similar to TDS, but it is used to collect tax on certain specified services.
TAN ensures that taxes are deducted and collected properly.
It makes it easier to file TDS and TCS returns.
It can help to prevent fraud.
It can help to speed up the processing of refunds and adjustments.
The TAN can also made use for generating TDS/TCS certificates and payment challans.
TAN correction refers to the process of amending any inaccuracies or errors in the data associated with a Tax Deduction Account Number (TAN).
A change in the name, address, or PAN of the TAN holder
A change in the category of the TAN holder (e.g., from 'firm' to 'company')
An error in the TAN number itself

template.value: ESIC monthly filing is the process of submitting the monthly contributions to the Employees State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) by employers. The ESIC monthly filing can be done online or offline. To file online, employers need to create an account on the ESIC portal and upload the monthly contribution details. To file offline, employers need to submit the monthly contribution details to the nearest ESIC office.

value: The ESIC monthly filing deadline is the 15th of the next month. For example, the deadline for filing the contributions for the month of January is the 15th of February.
IF employers fail to file the ESIC monthly contributions on time, they will be liable to pay a penalty.

The ESIC monthly filing is an important process for employers. It ensures that employees are covered by the ESIC scheme and that they can avail of the benefits of the scheme in case of sickness, maternity, or death.

title: PF Filing Online in Chennai
description: Aanoor Global is the best PF consultant in Chennai. EPF (Employee Provident Fund) is one of the significant advantages offered to the employees when they get relieved from a company or provided in a lump at the time of retirement.

template.value: Employees' Provident Fund Organization (EPFO) is a statutory body established under the Employees' Provident Fund and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952. It is responsible for administering the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF), Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS), and Employees' Deposit Linked Insurance (EDLI) schemes.

value.title: Provident Fund
value: The EPFO collects 12% of the basic salary and dearness allowance of each employee and the employer contributes an equal amount. The employee can withdraw the money from the provident fund after retirement or in case of certain other eligible events.

value.title: Pension
value: The EPFO also provides a pension scheme to its members. The pension is payable to the employee after retirement or in case of death. The pension amount is calculated based on the employee's salary and the number of years of service.

value.title: Interest
value: The EPFO also pays interest on the provident fund and pension contributions. The interest rate is declared by the government every year.

value.title: Medical benefits
value: The EPFO provides medical benefits to its members and their families. The medical benefits include hospitalization, surgery, and other medical expenses.

value.title: Maternity benefits
value: The EPFO provides maternity benefits to female employees. The maternity benefits include leave, medical expenses, and cash assistance.

value.title: Death benefits
value: The EPFO provides death benefits to the family members of deceased members. The death benefits include a lump sum amount and a monthly pension.

template.value: Shops and Establishment Registration is a legal requirement for all businesses that employ people in India. The specific requirements for registration vary from state to state, but there are some general similarities.

template.id: Key provisions of the Shop and Establishment Act
template.header: Key provisions of the Shop and Establishment Act

value.title: Hours of work
value: The Act sets limits on the number of hours that employees can work per day and per week.

value.title: Wages and benefits
value: The Act requires employers to pay employees at least the minimum wage and to provide them with certain benefits, such as paid leave and sick leave.

value.title: Child labor
value: The Act prohibits the employment of children under the age of 14.

value.title: Women's employment
value: The Act sets certain restrictions on the employment of women, such as the prohibition of night work for women.

value.title: Health and safety
value: The Act requires employers to provide a safe and healthy work environment for their employees.
